# WRD Media

> WRD Media is a Frisco, Texas company run by Howard Kan. It helps home service and outdoor living businesses get named on Google and in AI answers (Ascend), sell with interactive 3D design tools (Envision), and run their marketing with a fractional marketing director (Architect). Serving Frisco, McKinney, Prosper, and Dallas-Fort Worth.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://wrdmedia.com/services/): prices and what is included
- [Envision: 3D sales tools](https://wrdmedia.com/services/3d-sales-tools/): $5,000 setup plus $500 a month
- [Ascend: AI answer visibility](https://wrdmedia.com/services/ai-answer-visibility/): $3,000 sprint plus $1,000 a month
- [Architect: marketing director](https://wrdmedia.com/services/marketing-director/): $10,000 a month
